name: Sorcerer · Knight style A (both eyes)
description: Eldrin as he is today, redrawn in the plumed Knight’s style: an old wizard in a blue robe and a tall pointed blue hat with a gold band, a long white beard and white hair, a wooden staff crowned with a glowing fire orb in a gold claw, and a flame burning over his open palm. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material), blue ramps that run from violet shadow to cyan-white light, a pale lining at the robe’s opening, and fire as the one accent. The hat’s floppy point sways and blows back like the Knight’s plume, the robe tapers at the belt and its back hem ripples and trails like his cape, and beard, hair and bell sleeves swing a beat behind. His head is turned a little toward the viewer, so both eyes show under his bushy white brows, with the bridge of his big nose between them and the beard hanging from the turned chin. His attack gathers fire in the palm, swings it up behind his head as it swells into a blazing ball, and hurls it overhand in a big fiery crescent that flies off to the right, breaking into embers as he recovers. The fire (hand flame, staff orb, fireball and crescent) glows.
